brief: 2026 India-oriented premium phones with stronger high-aesthetic cultural expression

outputs.name: Bidri Midnight Inlay
visible_evidence: three descending real lenses and one pill flash form a clear optical hierarchy
silver-coloured routes visibly belong to the rigid camera shoulder and avoid the broad rear
black phone, warm pale background and neutral front remain coherent across both views
limitations: the inlay becomes several heavy concentric outlines rather than three finer embedded routes
the camera shoulder does not prove its frame-fed connection as strongly as requested
outputs.next_step: retain the black-and-silver craft direction while reducing the inlay to fewer finer lines and clarifying one frame attachment

outputs.name: Jali Shadow Glass
outputs.first_failed_rule: Phone Base Contract 0.1.3 section 5 — Camera Architecture
visible_evidence: the ivory chassis, champagne frame and graphite court create a premium high-contrast composition
three real lenses and a flash occupy the requested complete functional court
the internal diamond voids render as repeated decorative apertures and an unexplained dark flourish appears along the court floor
limitations: the solid–void layer is not visually separated from functional camera apertures
the extra flourish weakens structural credibility
outputs.next_step: replace open-looking voids with shallow under-glass relief and remove all free decorative linework

outputs.name: Stepwell Terrace
outputs.first_failed_rule: Phone Base Contract 0.1.3 section 4 — Evaluation-neutral front
visible_evidence: the two-level 1-over-2 camera terrace clearly expresses descending structure
teal and bronze levels have strong premium depth and coherent real-lens hierarchy
the front screen repeats the exterior teal colour instead of remaining evaluation-neutral
limitations: the main camera level is oversized and slightly disconnected from the lower optical row
the matching teal front contaminates exterior evaluation
outputs.next_step: keep the two-level descent but reduce the upper mass, tighten its overlap with the lower level and force a neutral charcoal front

outputs.name: Meenakari Precision Edge
visible_evidence: three real lenses, one subordinate flash and one rigid bridge remain functionally clear
bounded colour cells visibly integrate with the retaining edge rather than becoming a rear skin
indigo chassis and pale cool background provide strong silhouette separation
limitations: the generated colour-cell count appears greater than the requested nine
the jewel-like edge approaches decorative luxury and needs strict scale control for family use
outputs.next_step: retain the bounded colour-within-metal principle while reducing cell count and saturation

verdict: two pass, two reject; all images retained and no output regenerated
schema_learning: Schema 1.4.0 can support stronger premium cultural expression when the carrier is a bounded rigid functional part, as shown by Bidri-inspired inlay and Meenakari-inspired retention cells. Open-looking Jali voids risk becoming decorative camera apertures, and strong form experiments still require strict neutral-front enforcement. No Schema revision is promoted from one batch.
